evidence_score.method: Mean of the five sub-scores, rounded to two decimals.

feature_usability.method: 100 minus (raw points ÷ feature count), clamped to 0–100 and rounded to two decimals.

policy.threshold: Majority class ≥ 75% of labelled rows (High from 90%)
policy.effect: Finding; target-balance sub-score falls as the majority share exceeds an even split.

policy.threshold: ≥ 5% / ≥ 10% of rows outside 1.5 × IQR fences (non-finite counted)

policy.effect: Finding; completeness sub-score is 100 minus the missing-cell rate.
Finding; uniqueness sub-score is 100 minus the duplicate rate.

policy.rule: Guardrails: severe missingness or duplicates; missing labels
policy.threshold: Feature ≥ 50% missing; cells ≥ 25% missing; duplicates ≥ 10%; any missing label

policy.effect: Name-based only; strong candidates cost 40 points (+15 each further, at most 85).

candidate_rules.meaning: Candidates are suggestions only; nothing is interpreted until you declare it.
